# Eyes On Eyecare

> The #1 eyecare resource providing clinical education, continuing education credits, industry news, and career support for optometrists and ophthalmologists.

Eyes On Eyecare is a comprehensive platform serving eyecare professionals with evidence-based clinical guides, mentorship content, FDA regulatory updates, and professional development opportunities. The site covers major specialty areas including optometry, ophthalmology, retina, glaucoma, dry eye disease, and refractive surgery.

## Key Topics

- Dry Eye Disease (DED)
- FDA Approvals & Regulatory Updates
- Clinical Guides
- Continuing Education (CE/CME Credits)
- Retinal Diseases (AMD, Diabetic Retinopathy)
- Glaucoma Management
- Refractive Surgery
- Medical Devices
- Optometry Scope of Practice
- Mentorship & Career Development
- Evidence-Based Practice
- Eyecare Industry News
- Cataract & IOL Surgery
- Myopia Management
- Ocular Surface Disease

## Core Specialties

- [Optometry](https://eyesoneyecare.com/optometry): Main optometry section with clinical guides, career resources, and professional content
- [Ophthalmology](https://eyesoneyecare.com/ophthalmology): Main ophthalmology section covering surgery, refractive procedures, and clinical guides

## Continuing Education & Events

- [Eyes On Eyecare Courses](https://courses.eyesoneyecare.com): CE/CME course platform with COPE and AMA PRA Category 1 credits available
- [Eyes On Eyecare Events](https://events.eyesoneyecare.com): Digital events platform offering CE credits for optometrists and ophthalmologists
- [Continuing Education Hub](https://events.eyesoneyecare.com/live-ce-cme): Hub for claiming CE/CME credits from Eyes On Eyecare live webinar events

## Clinical Education Series

- [Interventional Mindset](https://eyesoneyecare.com/interventional-mindset): Clinical guides on premium IOL selection, refractive surgery, and cataract procedures
- [Evidence Based Retina](https://eyesoneyecare.com/evidence-based-retina): Evidence-based retina clinical guides on diabetic retinopathy and AMD treatment
- [Ready Set Retina](https://eyesoneyecare.com/ready-set-retina): Clinical conversations on geographic atrophy, AMD, and retina disease management
- [Retina Mentor Moments](https://eyesoneyecare.com/retina-mentor-moments): Mentorship content on vitreoretinal careers, disease management, and career guidance
- [Pressure Points Glaucoma](https://eyesoneyecare.com/pressure-points-glaucoma): Glaucoma management education on IOP treatment options and patient compliance
- [Dry Eye Fireside Chat](https://eyesoneyecare.com/dry-eye-fireside-chat): Clinical discussion on dry eye disease, ocular surface disease, and biologic therapy

## Industry News & Regulatory Updates

- [Glance by Eyes On Eyecare](https://glance.eyesoneyecare.com): Breaking eyecare industry news curated for clinicians on FDA approvals and updates
- [Kansas passes optometry scope of expansion bill for laser procedures](https://glance.eyesoneyecare.com/stories/2026-03-18/kansas-passes-optometry-scope-of-expansion-bill-for-laser-procedures): Kansas H.B. 2227 expands optometry scope for laser procedures like capsulotomy
- [FDA issues third CRL to Aldeyra, rejecting reproxalap NDA](https://glance.eyesoneyecare.com/stories/2026-03-17/fda-issues-third-crl-to-aldeyra-rejecting-reproxalap-nda): FDA rejects Aldeyra's reproxalap dry eye disease treatment for third time

## Career & Recruitment

- [Eyecare Hiring Services](https://jobs.eyesoneyecare.com/eyecare-hiring-products): Job board and recruiting services for eyecare hiring and talent acquisition
